ValidationRule.description: Validation rule to check that the end date for OOO should be greater than the start date
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( ( Out_Of_Office_End_Date__c < Out_Of_Office_Start_Date__c ), AND( Out_Of_Office_End_Date__c>= TODAY(), ISBLANK(Out_Of_Office_Message__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Incorrect Out Of Office values. Please enter Out Of office start date, Out of Office End Date and Out of Office message.
